title: Self-Improving Program Optimizer — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Proposes code improvements, benchmarks them, and retains changes only when they meet defined criteria. A proposed optimizer that rewrites code to make it better — faster, leaner, clearer — then benchmarks each proposed change and keeps it only when it meets defined acceptance criteria. Rejected proposals are logged with the reason, so the optimizer learns which transformations pay off for which code shapes.
